crossRefs.note: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.
Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.
Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.
nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.
receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects…

translations.web: is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not joking?”
translations.bsb: so is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “I was only joking!”
translations.kjv: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, and saith, Am not I in sport?
translations.asv: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbor, And saith, Am not I in sport?
